_comment: Estado unico da auditoria pergunta-a-pergunta (240 perguntas / 12 eixos). Um objeto por catalogo. Veja README.md para o processo completo.

expansion.scope: Preserve nineteen completed additions. Finish the narrowed contemporary and US shortlist: Kamala Harris, Hillary Clinton, Jimmy Carter, Lyndon B. Johnson, Mark Carney, Angela Merkel and Olaf Scholz. At the user’s request, also add five major historical figures: David Lloyd George, Helmut Kohl, Lech Wałęsa, David Ben-Gurion and Golda Meir. Winston Churchill, Justin Trudeau, Dominik Tarczyński, Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un already have complete catalogue entries and must not be duplicated. Earlier excluded candidates remain out of scope unless explicitly restored by this amendment. Submit the draft PR after retained work and final verification are complete.
expansion.method: Individual 240-question and five-archetype simulations, computed with profile_vector.py; bilingual metadata, real compressed portraits and dated per-axis research. Answers are editorial inferences, not claims that the person took the quiz.

scopeRevision.userRequest: Decrease the number of people you are doing per country to just the most notable.
selectionCriteria: National or international recognition, lasting historical impact, or major contemporary political significance.
Account for existing catalogue coverage and retain a mix of historical and contemporary figures across political traditions.
Preserve all thirteen explicitly requested Australian profiles and all completed work.
scopeRevision.exclusionNote: These candidates were removed to narrow the workload at the user's request. Exclusion is not an evidence-quality finding and does not count as a researched skip.

scopeAmendments.userRequest: Send me your full list. Also add Rupert Lowe.

Cut most of those because they are not noteable enough except for the US ones. Add Tredeau, Carney. Add Merkel, Scholz. Add Dominik Tarczynski. Add Xi Jinping if he's there. If he's not there, add Kim Jong Un if he's not there. You can cut most of those less notable European ones.
scopeAmendments.interpretation: Trudeau means Justin Trudeau. Retain all four US candidates from the current shortlist and the three explicitly requested missing profiles. Other pending candidates are removed from this expansion; completed additions and existing catalogue entries are retained. Justin Trudeau, Dominik Tarczyński, Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un were verified to already have PT/EN metadata, twelve-axis profiles and portraits.
scopeAmendments.exclusionNote: Scope reduction requested by the user; these are not researched evidence-quality skips.

scopeAmendments.userRequest: Add historical people too who have been significantly notable for example Winston Churchill if they are not already there.
scopeAmendments.selectionCriteria: A small historical supplement focused on internationally consequential leaders: wartime British leadership, German reunification, the Polish Solidarity movement and the founding and early leadership of Israel. Preserve the narrowed contemporary shortlist rather than restore all excluded country lists.
scopeAmendments.historicalExclusionNote: Earlier scope exclusions remain as history. This amendment restores these five people to active work; Lech Wałęsa uses the corrected transliterated slug lech-walesa, replacing the never-added candidate slug lech-waesa.
